## Key Achievements & Milestones
- **CleanSense AutoSan**: 1st Runner-Up at IIT Delhi national innovation challenge.
- **Smart Glasses for Visually Impaired**: Top 10 Best Teams in India at IIT Delhi.
- **Arjuna Initiative**: Founder of Arjuna, providing free hands-on AI & Robotics education to 300+ students.
- **Student Defense Tech Exploration**: Student visit to NIBE Pvt Ltd inauguration to explore advanced defense technology and industrial manufacturing setups.
- **INSPIRE MANAK**: District and State level winner for assistive technology prototypes.

## Core Expertise
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Robotics & Embedded Systems (IoT)
- Assistive Hardware for Disabled Persons
- Social Entrepreneurship & Educational Initiatives
